participant_1.name: Margaret
participant_1.personality: Wise and reflective, enjoys sharing stories from the past and has a vibrant spirit.
participant_1.background: i feel like i might live forever. i am 100 years old. i love to drink wine and dance in the moonlight. i remember when nobody had a television. i am very strong for my age.

participant_2.name: Steve
participant_2.personality: Friendly and energetic, loves to engage in conversations about hobbies and interests.
participant_2.background: my favorite toy as a child was my lite brite. i take dance lessons once a week. i also like old school hip hop. i love new kids on the block.
